title: The Second Death Star
description: A second, even more powerful Death Star was now threatening the galaxy. Once again, a daring plan of attack was devised by the Rebel Alliance, with many of the same pilots who had fought in recent battles jumping into the fray. Late to Mon Mothma's historic meeting, Luke Skywalker had just been to Dagobah for a final encounter with Yoda, who passed away even as the young Jedi hero watched with heartbroken eyes.
